component.name: Agent Workspace
component.summary: Local dashboard for coding-agent CLI worktrees

description.p: Agent Workspace is a small local HTTP dashboard that watches every directory under ~/git/worktrees/<workspace>/<repo>, surfaces a GitHub-style activity heatmap of your commits, and lets you launch a coding-agent CLI in a terminal tab — Claude Code, OpenAI Codex CLI, Aider, Gemini CLI, Cursor Agent, or Crush. It tracks token usage and session liveness per workspace, and never runs git mutations behind your back.

ul.li: Pluggable agent CLI providers (six supported out of the box).
Activity heatmap of your commits over the last 365 days.
Per-workspace agent terminal embedded in the dashboard.
Cross-agent messaging via MCP (Claude Code provider).
Opt-in cross-machine state sync via a user-supplied git repo.

screenshot.caption: The Agent Workspace dashboard with the activity heatmap and per-workspace tabs.

description.p: Initial release with multi-agent provider support and Flatpak/Snap packaging.
